notes:
**Fixes the freeze 1.8.0 caused. Take this update.**

1.8.0 tried to reach a piece of the engine that is not normally reachable, by trying possibilities
until one appeared to work. One of them appeared to work and did not — it reported the video as 2
pixels wide — and the check accepted that instead of rejecting it as obvious nonsense. The game
then hung on the loading screen. That was my mistake and it is removed, not disabled.

Everything else stays: the video still loads and plays, the overlay is still built and waiting for
Battle Royale, and the off switch still works. The video itself will render blank until there is a
safe way to give it a drawing surface — which is a real remaining problem, not a solved one.

If 1.8.0 left your game stuck, this update clears it.
